reviews.text:
I have owned dogs my whole life, but I have never dealt with a breed as stubborn as my hound. I wanted a companion dog, but his drive to hunt and bark made him feel unstoppable. I realized I didn't know how to properly handle a stubborn working breed, and online research wasn't cutting it.
​That is where Macey came in. She didn't just train my dog; she taught me how to keep up with his training at home. We identified his triggers and even started scent training to give him a 'job' to do. I have learned more from her than I ever did on my own. She offers various training plans and is flexible with payment options. If you find yourself with a stubborn, aggressive, or uncontrollable dog, give her a call. You won't be disappointed!
Great trainer and great team. They  did a damn good job with Dallas.

Macy did an amazing job with our 100 lb 1 year old bloodhound Sissy.  If you know bloodhounds you know they are very stubborn, slobbery and sweet all rolled in one.  I bought all sorts of books thinking I could train her myself but learned real quick that wasn’t a job for me.   Just like I couldn’t home school my kids that’s definitely a special job for a special teacher and that’s not me.  So if you are debating on getting a trainer or training yourself do yourself a favor and call Macy.  She texted pictures and videos throughout Sissy’s time there training.  You will not be disappointed.  Thank you Macy for giving me my “personal space” back 😊
Macey is a great trainer, my puppy is a different puppy.  Well behaved and listens.  Loved all the updates Macey gave with pictures and videos during my dog’s training.

The “dog whisperer”! We are very pleased with the education provided not just to our baby but us as well. Macie took her time walking us through commands with our pup. We have a better understanding of our role in our dogs life. Macey also gave us great recommendations for tools that will contribute to our success.

Macey did an amazing job helping with training my Giant Schnauzer. I was having a lot of troubles with boundaries, obedience, jumping, and walking without pulling. We did the 6 week board and train and I’m so happy with the results. No more …
Had a very good experience with Macey! She helped us and our pup learn basic obedience, so now going on a walk or out in public is an enjoyable bonding experience for us and our pup.

Macey’s knowledge and experience has helped our dog with appropriate greetings. I so appreciate the time she has taken to understand our dog and then teach me the needed skills. Our dog has improved so much thanks to her guidance.

I have had the pleasure of working with Macey for a few months. My intention was basic training to integrate a new family member.
I also wanted my puppy/dog to be evaluated for possible therapy training. …
